_readme: Single source of truth for the load order of the /app frontend.
`npm run build` concatenates each classic group in this exact order,
minifies it and writes a content-hashed file to static/dist/.
app/core/assets.py renders the tags from the same list, so a new script
is added here and nowhere else -- there is no ?v= mark left to forget.
Order is load order. An entry may be a plain path or {file, note}.

groups.name: head
groups.note: Render-blocking on purpose: seeds state (agent mode, theme, auth) before the first paint.

files.note: Defines window.App.emailVerification before the Firebase module consumes it. It is listed directly so source-mode cache busting covers it.
Must be in place before anything can throw.
Same-origin watchdog: stays active even when the Firebase CDN modules cannot be imported. Must run before firebase.js.

groups.name: firebase
groups.note: ESM. Reads window.App.emailVerification from the head group; the gstatic Firebase SDK stays an external CDN import.

groups.name: app
groups.note: Everything deferred. app-init.js and app-dom-events.js used to sit at the end of <body>; deferred scripts only run after parsing, so their position in the document does not change execution order.

files.note: Shared base (window.App): central config + helpers. MUST load first.
Shared LaTeX preparation; must load before markdown-stream.js.
Needs consensus-actions.js and the share modal.
memory-edit.js fills it from the text selection, query-send.js prepends it when sending.
Must follow every feature module: aliases window.App.* and runs initApp() on DOMContentLoaded. app-dom-events.js then installs the remaining document-level listeners.

styles.name: app
styles.note: @import aggregator. The build inlines the imports in cascade order into one hashed file; static/dist/ is a sibling of static/css/, so every relative url(../fonts/...) still resolves.
